US-Iran Tensions Escalate After Attack Kills American Soldiers

Following an attack that killed three American soldiers, the United States is increasing its military presence in the Middle East, deploying additional fighter jets and placing troops on alert. This escalation follows Iran's attacks and comes amid broader regional instability, with reports of significant damage in Iran and impact on several Middle Eastern countries.
